generator: HelioSI paper-to-skill factory (HelioSI paper-to-skill factory — Claude Opus 4.7)
harness_framing: Skills are runtime-neutral: loadable by any general-purpose agent runtime (Claude Code, LingTai, Codex, Cursor, OpenAI Assistants, …). Named runtimes / MCPs / repos appear only as adapter examples. Each SKILL.md exposes four layers — scientific-invariant, executable-protocol (abstract capability contracts), adapter notes (optional), research-generation affordances (§10).

layer_model.1_scientific_invariant: claims, equations, methods, data assumptions, failure modes, figure / numerical targets — runtime-neutral
layer_model.2_executable_protocol: abstract capability contracts (e.g., 'load PSP/ISʘIS L2', 'fit power-law') — not bound to any specific API, MCP, or runtime
layer_model.3_adapter_notes: named tools, MCPs, repos, libraries — example adapters satisfying the contract; substitutable
layer_model.4_research_generation_affordances: gaps, tensions, new hypotheses, follow-up experiments when composed with prior skills in the corpus — see SKILL.md §10

compilation_framing.model: Each paper compiled into a runtime-neutral Skill — claims → verifiable tasks; methods/equations → executable workflows; data/instruments → abstract tool / capability contracts; caveats → skill memory; figures/results → benchmark artifacts; corpus/citations → skill graph (depends_on); plus research-generation affordances (§10 of each SKILL.md) for gap/tension/hypothesis/experiment seeds.

skills.title: The Physics of Solar Energetic Particles
skills.core_claim: Two-mechanism SEP framework: reconnection-jet impulsive events (3He/heavy-ion-rich, type-III) vs. CME-driven-shock gradual events (streaming-limit-flattened upstream, downstream reservoir, FIP-biased composition); residual-impulsive ions reaccelerated at later shocks.

skills.title: Magnetic reconnection-driven energization of protons up to 400 keV at the near-Sun heliospheric current sheet
skills.core_claim: PSP at ~16.25 R_sun observes trapped energetic protons up to ~400 keV in a Sunward HCS reconnection exhaust with γ ~ -5 spectrum; kglobal merging-islands model with guide field 0.2-0.3 reproduces.

skills.title: Compression Acceleration of Protons and Heavier Ions at the Heliospheric Current Sheet
skills.core_claim: 2D MHD reconnecting HCS + Parker transport produces multi-species power-laws consistent with PSP; E_max(proton) ~ 0.1-1 MeV; (Q/M)^α scaling with α ≈ 0.4 under quasilinear-Kolmogorov, vs ~0.7 observed.

skills.title: Direct Measurements of Synchrotron-Emitting Electrons at Near-Sun Shocks
skills.core_claim: First in-situ synchrotron-electron measurements at PSP-traveling near-Sun shocks; strong quasi-parallel shocks emit substantially more than strong quasi-perpendicular shocks due to efficient ultra-relativistic electron acceleration.

skills.title: SEP environment in the inner heliosphere from Solar Orbiter and Parker Solar Probe
skills.core_claim: Inner-heliospheric energetic-particle environment is the superposition of SEPs, ESPs, anomalous CRs, and planetary-bow-shock-accelerated populations, resolved by joint SO/EPD + PSP/ISʘIS observations.
verification_flags: Authorship expansion of 'Solar Orbiter EPD team' required at promotion.

skills.title: Observations of Kappa Distributions in Solar Energetic Protons and Derived Thermodynamic Properties
skills.core_claim: PSP/ISʘIS EPI-Hi protons (10-60 MeV) across a single ICME + driven shock are well-fit by kappa distributions; κ_EP peaks at ~3.5 in CME ejecta; T_EP/n_EP anti-correlated (sub-isothermal polytropic) and T_EP/κ_EP positively correlated (increasing entropy).

skills.title: Variability in energetic particle observations at strong interplanetary shocks: Multi-spacecraft observations
skills.core_claim: For a single strong IP shock observed in radial alignment by Wind/ACE (1 au) and SO (0.8 au), cross-correlated energetic-particle profiles vary with energy; >0.5 MeV profile shapes differ between 0.8 au and 1 au due to shock evolution and ambient/shock irregularities.

skills.title: Shock properties for solar energetic particle events with signatures of inverse velocity arrival
skills.core_claim: 26 IVA-SEP events 2018-2025 observed by SO+PSP; 3D shock reconstruction + coronal MHD show connectivity migrates from weak flanks toward strong shock apex over the event, producing delayed high-energy arrivals consistent with time-dependent diffusive shock acceleration.

skills.title: Parker Solar Probe observations of solar energetic particle (SEP) events with inverse velocity arrival (IVA) features
skills.core_claim: First PSP/ISʘIS IVA-event catalog through end-2024: 14 events detected by a contour-line-of-intensity method; 11/14 fall in the medium nose-energy bin (0.5-5 MeV); 2022-09-05 Labor Day event is canonical.

skills.title: Velocity dispersion of Solar Energetic Particles in turbulent heliosphere
skills.core_claim: Full-orbit proton simulations in a Parker-spiral IMF + 2D-dominant turbulence show VDA-derived injection times are 2-16 min biased late and path lengths 0.2-0.3 au longer than the Parker spiral (weak/moderate turb); >5 au for strong turbulence; background-spectrum shape adds 5-20 min injection-time bias.

skills.title: Radial Dependency of ICME-associated Particle Acceleration Processes: Statistical Multipoint Observations from 2016-2023
skills.core_claim: 39-event multipoint ICME catalog 2016-2023 (PSP+SO+ACE+Wind+STEREO-A): shock-acceleration efficiency increases with heliocentric distance while parent ICME is within ~0.7 au, then decreases beyond.

skills.title: On the reason for the widespread energetic storm particle event of 13 March 2023
skills.core_claim: 13 March 2023 widespread SEP/ESP event observed at six heliospheric observers (PSP/SO/BepiColombo/STEREO-A/near-Earth/MAVEN) with in-situ shocks at all inner-heliospheric observers; both MHD scenarios (single blast-wave shock and multi-CME combined shocks) fit the global ESP signature; blast-wave performs slightly better.
